title: SpaceX单季度支出184亿美元——其中158亿美元用于人工智能。资金流向如下。
content:
SpaceX Spent $18.4 Billion in a Single Quarter -- $15.8 Billion of It on AI. Here's Where the Money Is Going.
In the second quarter of 2026, SpaceX's (NASDAQ: SPCX) revenue surged 92% year over year to $7.8 billion, and it narrowed its net loss from $1.01 billion to $541 million. However, its total capex surged more than sixfold year over year, from $2.83 billion to $18.37 billion. It allocated $15.8 billion of that capex to expanding its AI business. Let's see where all that money went.
Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »
What AI investments did SpaceX make?
SpaceX originally operated two main businesses: its Starlink satellite internet services and its rocket launch services. But in Feb. 2026, it acquired xAI -- which owns Grok, X, and its other AI assets -- in an all-stock transaction to form its new AI business. It also acquired the AI start-up Cursor earlier this month. Elon Musk believes its AI revenue will jump from $3.5 billion in 2025 to $700-$750 billion in 2030.
To sow the seeds for that expansion, SpaceX spent most of its second-quarter capex on Nvidia's (NASDAQ: NVDA) data center GPUs and other AI accelerators. The rest was used to deploy, acquire, and build more high-power data centers to increase its active capacity from 1.4 GW today to its target of 10 GW by next year.
That would give it a lot more bandwidth to handle its multi-billion-dollar compute hosting contracts with external enterprise clients. However, the expansion of that unprofitable AI business could offset Starlink's profits and keep its bottom line in the red.

report.summary: SpaceX单季度资本开支184亿美元，其中158亿投向AI扩张。
report.background: SpaceX原本以星链卫星互联网和火箭发射为主业。2026年2月，马斯克通过全股票交易将xAI（旗下有Grok、X等AI资产）并入SpaceX，随后又收购AI编程初创公司Cursor，正式组建AI业务板块。为了支撑马斯克提出的AI收入从2025年35亿美元跃升至2030年7000-7500亿美元的目标，SpaceX在2026年第二季度将绝大部分资本开支用于购买Nvidia数据中心GPU和扩建高功耗数据中心，计划将算力从1.4GW提升至明年10GW。
key_points: SpaceX单季度总资本开支达184亿美元，同比暴增超6倍，其中158亿美元流向AI，占86%。
核心支出用于采购Nvidia数据中心GPU和其他AI加速器，以扩充算力基础设施。
大量资金用于部署和建设高功耗数据中心，目标将算力从1.4GW提升至明年10GW。
SpaceX通过收购xAI和Cursor快速切入AI赛道，形成Grok、X和AI编程工具的产品矩阵。
尽管AI业务带来外部企业算力托管合同，但巨额投入可能持续拖累整体利润。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，SpaceX巨资采购GPU将加剧高端算力需求紧张，推高数据中心建设成本；对开发者来说，xAI和Cursor的整合可能催生更强大的AI编程工具与模型生态；对普通用户而言，SpaceX加速AI商业化可能让Grok等产品更快迭代，但短期财务状况仍承压，需关注其AI业务能否按预期增收。
report.tools: 可关注Nvidia（GPU供应链）、xAI旗下Grok（模型）、Cursor（AI编程工具），以及SpaceX官方财报和Starlink业务动态，了解AI算力投资如何落地。
